fixture: Synthetic 2x2 hex board with opaque cell/vertex/edge IDs, explicit cell indices, pink lower-left shade, clue17, blue shared edge and red vertex note at the lower tip.
scope: Columns2to3 retain vertex note, annotations, Undo/Redo and native file. Paint a newly allocated cell using mouse or touchscreen. Columns3to1 remove new paint and retain the surviving shared edge. Units additionally cover odd top/left margins, hidden cells, deformation, malformed phase rejection, legacy hit testing and atomic trial restoration. Other tilings and merge/split/sculpt remain unresolved.
